oscillator.title: From Swimming to Walking with a Salamander Robot Driven by a Spinal Cord Model
oscillator.organism_context: Salamander and physical robot, not zebrafish
oscillator.read_locator: p1416 displayed phase, amplitude and positive burst equations; p1417 Fig1 caption: PD feedback controllers driven by oscillator angle setpoints
oscillator.used_for: Amplitude-controlled phase oscillator form, phase-biased coupling, opponent setpoint and PD architecture; no robot/source parameter calibration is copied

zebrafish_context.read_locator: Results: Generation of swimming pattern by spinal network oscillators (>2–3dpf), Figs1 and4; Methods: Musculoskeletal model Eqs5–7; Availability of code
zebrafish_context.used_for: Primary computational zebrafish study gives rostrocaudal, left-right alternating pattern context and discusses20–65Hz bouts. Chosen35Hz is a scenario inside that discussed range, not a fitted observation. Damped angle-proxy architecture is contextual motivation only.
zebrafish_context.difference: No Izhikevich neurons, biological cell types, synapses, muscle voltages or published zebrafish circuit figure is reproduced. The present oscillator derives from a separate salamander/robot source; parameters and actuator are designed assumptions.
zebrafish_context.raw_data_validation: Not attempted. The source's public dataset DOI10.20383/102.0498 was discovered but not retrieved/replayed.
